authorization_basis: The project owner explicitly authorized limited local ComfyUI/Ollama startup and the fixed testSource media.
The project owner authorized Codex implementation-role substitution until V0 completes.
Offline diagnosis proved WSL child environment variables were absent in Windows cmd.exe while Windows-native cmd and PowerShell assignment retained OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1.

allowed.ollama_start_route: Windows-native environment assignment in a run-owned cmd.exe or PowerShell wrapper, then OLLAMA_EXE serve
allowed.comfy: fresh run-owned Windows temp base, sealed candidate copy, 127.0.0.1:8191, original installation read-only

forbidden: continuing when OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD is false or absent
continuing after any owned non-loopback TCP observation
firewall, hosts-file, registry or permanent environment modification
downloads, upgrades or permanent target installation writes
visible browser startup or remote Git push
mandatory_stops: candidate, model digest or sample hash mismatch
GPU memory reaches or exceeds 23552 MiB
public Comfy trace or per-run cleanup cannot be proven
cleanup: stop owned listener and wrapper PIDs, prove 8191/11434 empty, prove /api/ps terminal state, remove run-owned temp only, verify target integrity
expires_when: WP-S0-10 produces one terminal receipt or either single effective attempt is consumed
